original_question: Write a Verilog module named `nor3_module`. This module should have three single-bit inputs: `A`, `B`, and `C_N`, and a single-bit output `Y`. The output `Y` should represent the logical NOR of the three inputs `A`, `B`, and `C_N`. Implement the core logic using a continuous assignment. Your module should also include declarations for a `supply1` signal named `VPWR` and a `supply0` signal named `VGND`.
